children: Abhinav Anand of ITC Maurya and Nadikota Srinivasa Rao of Novotel Visakhapatnam Varun Beach were jointly named National Winners in the Head of IT category at BW Hotelier IHA 2026

The prestigious BW Hotelier Indian Hospitality Awards (IHA 2026) ceremony on day two was graced by the presence KB Kachru, President, Hotels Association of India (HAI) and Chairman- Radisson Hotels Group (South Asia). The event, a cornerstone of the Indian hospitality calendar, celebrated the pinnacle of achievement across various domains, recognising the individuals who are the driving force behind India's ascent as a global hospitality leader.

Under the theme ‘India’s Hospitality Decade: From Growth to Greatness’, the awards honoured the industry's crème de la crème. The Head of Information Technology category was presented by Dr Anurag Batra, Bhuvanesh Khanna, KB Kachru, The BNK Group and Rattan Keswani, Former Dy MD, Lemon Tree Hotels, who came together on stage to felicitate the winners, including the two national winners in the category.
The winners for each category were commended for their dedication to enhancing well-being. The BW Hotelier IHA 2026 Award for Head of IT   was presented to the following regional winners:
* EAST - Kamal Roy  -  Mayfair Oasis Resort & Convention Jharsuguda
* WEST- Nandkishor G. Jaiswal - Fairmont Mumbai & Sofitel Mumbai BKC
* SOUTH - Nadikota Srinivasa Rao - Novotel Visakhapatnam Varun Beach
National winners are Abhinav Anand from ITC Maurya and Nadikota Srinivasa Rao from Novotel Visakhapatnam Varun Beach

The two-day BW Hotelier Indian Hospitality Summit & Awards (IHA 2026) encompassed over 25 sessions where hospitality veterans and experts across the nation gathered to provide diverse knowledge and insights. The Summit & Awards is a testament to BW Hotelier’s commitment towards revolutionising Indian hospitality by honouring the crème de la crème of the industry.
